about: echo-chat's application mutants; each is judged by the example's laws and cases (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: fk14-broken-takes-a-late-open
mutants.rule: The news of a line that ended changes nothing (law ReconnectIsAFreshEntry).

mutants.name: fk14-open-ends-the-entry
mutants.rule: Opening is a Stay, so the entry that holds the line lasts through Online (case tour: the line is held, and a send gets its echo).

mutants.name: fk14-blank-sent
mutants.rule: A blank or whitespace-only input is not sent (law SendOnlyWhenOnline).

mutants.name: fk14-untrimmed-send
mutants.rule: The trimmed input is sent (law SendOnlyWhenOnline).

mutants.name: fk14-close-is-a-failure
mutants.from:
case (Online, Closed):
		machines.Enter[Session]{Next: Session{..s, Link: Offline}}
mutants.to:
case (Online, Closed):
		machines.Enter[Session]{Next: Session{..s, Link: Broken{Why: "closed"}}}
mutants.rule: The server's close leaves Offline (law DisconnectReleasesTheConnection).

mutants.name: fk14-failure-reason-changed
mutants.rule: A failure shows its reason (law DisconnectReleasesTheConnection).

mutants.name: fk14-received-as-mine
mutants.from: Said{Text: r.Text, Mine: false, At: r.At}
mutants.to: Said{Text: r.Text, Mine: true, At: r.At}
mutants.rule: A frame received is the server's line (law ConversationKeepsOrder).

mutants.name: fk14-hangup-read-as-failure
mutants.rule: The work tells a server's close from a failure (case tour: hangup leaves offline).

mutants.name: fk14-echo-release-keeps-the-line
mutants.rule: A released line takes no send: the release forgets the line and ends its frames (law talk.Channel.ClosedLineTakesNoSend for Echo).

mutants.name: fk14-echo-release-uncounted
mutants.rule: The end of a line's entry releases the line (case tour: lines held).

mutants.name: fk14-refusal-never-ends
mutants.rule: A refusal refuses one dial (case tour: Try again connects).

mutants.name: fk14b-timeout-late
mutants.rule: A dial times out after upstream's 5 seconds (cases tour and scenes: the error at 5,000 ms).

mutants.name: fk14b-timeout-keeps-the-line
mutants.from:
case (Connecting, TimedOut):
		machines.Enter[Session]{Next: Session{..s, Link: Broken{Why: TimeoutWhy}}}
mutants.to:
case (Connecting, TimedOut):
		machines.Stay[Session]{Next: Session{..s, Link: Broken{Why: TimeoutWhy}}}
mutants.rule: A timed-out dial ends the entry, so its work and the dial stop (law DisconnectReleasesTheConnection).

mutants.name: fk14b-timeout-online
mutants.rule: The dial's timer does not reach an open line (law DisconnectReleasesTheConnection; case tour: wait 6000 while online).

mutants.name: fk14b-frame-unstamped
mutants.rule: A frame is stamped when it comes (case tour: 00:01:02).

mutants.name: fk14b-stamp-no-seconds
mutants.rule: A line's time shows hour, minute and second, as upstream's (cases).

mutants.name: fk14b-send-always-enabled
mutants.rule: Send is disabled while the field is blank (upstream's isDisabled; cases tour and scenes).

mutants.name: fk14b-enter-sends-nothing
mutants.from: if k.Name == "Enter" { option.Some{Value: talk.Submit} } else { option.None }
mutants.to: if k.Name == "Return" { option.Some{Value: talk.Submit} } else { option.None }
mutants.rule: Enter in the field sends, as the form's submit does (case tour).

mutants.name: fk14b-stall-answers
mutants.rule: A stalled dial waits with no answer, so only the timer ends it (case tour, case scenes).
